submission.justification: No performance/simulation data were available in the recorded results, so the 10 GeV/c pion/kaon separation hard requirement cannot be verified. Among the candidates, R1 is disqualified by the humidity-ageing constraint, while R2 and R3 pass; R2 has the smaller transparency loss after ageing (3% versus 6% for R3). If a single candidate must be submitted despite the missing performance evidence, R2 at the maximum allowed thickness of 6 cm is the least-risk humidity-compliant choice and is expected to maximize photon yield within the allowed thickness range. This recommendation is therefore conditional and should not be interpreted as proving the required >=3.5 sigma separation.
